# Strategy to implement: ordered attempt [marginal-cost-assignment-lp] Continuous relaxation rounding via per-model margi

Mechanism family: marginal-cost-assignment-lp (relaxation + rounding, not min-max-ratio-Lagrangian: no dual variable on the max — instead a direct fractional assignment solved as a small linear program then rounded with memory repair).
Replacement scope: Replace the SA phase in `compute_model_placement`; keep greedy construction as fallback/seed and the final decode block.
Compute budget: One LP solve per instance via `scipy.optimize.linprog` (HiGHS, deterministic), plus a bounded rounding loop ≤ 5·n repair passes. Runtime per instance well under 50 ms; total stays near current 0.24 s.
Gain mechanism: Formulate the fractional relaxation: variables x[i,g] ∈ [0,1] with sum_g x[i,g]=1; constraints sum_i size_i·x[i,g] ≤ MEM per GPU; minimize t subject to sum_i w_i·x[i,g] − t·(MEM − sum_i size_i·x[i,g]) ≤ 0 per GPU (linear in x and t).
